title: Developer Color Palettes
subtitle: Click any color box or hex code to copy it to your clipboard.
aboutText: Choosing harmonious color schemes is essential for user interface design. This curated collection provides balanced hex code combinations optimized for modern dark and light user interface themes.
howToTitle: How to Use the Palette Tool
step1: Browse the available curated color combinations for your UI project.
step2: Click directly on any color swatch or hex label to copy the hex code.
step3: Paste the copied color values into your CSS, Tailwind, or design tool.
faq1A: The tool copies standard 6-digit hex codes (e.g. #0f172a) ready for CSS stylesheets.
faq2Q: Can I use these palettes in commercial projects?
faq2A: Yes, all hex code combinations are open for royalty-free personal and commercial use.
